title: A personal space: one private conversation with Sophia, notes the person keeps, and notes carried to a project one at a time
why: Luis's direction C (docs/goals/personal-space.md, PR #21): everyone who signs up has a private space with Sophia beside the work space. Personal data lives in its own owner-only tables (0021), never in project tables with a flag; no project role reaches it.

The only crossing is a per-item release (carryPersonalNote): one note, exactly as written, to one project the person belongs to; members read it attributed to its owner, who can take it back. The team companion reads nothing personal (D5 kept at no until Davide confirms).

Sophia's replies come from the companion the API runs. This slice ships a keyless rehearsal (scripted, development only); the runtime's Companion agent (D1) replaces it without changing these operations. Where none runs, sending is refused with nothing kept. listProjects gives the Work side its list; the contract had none.

epoch.description: Moves with each erasure: a write names the epoch it was made against, and one made against another is refused.

days.description: The days on which the person wrote, over the whole conversation (not only the turns listed), as `timeZone` counts them (UTC without it).

next.description: Where the next page starts (pass it as `after`); null on the last page.

personalEpoch.description: The reader's personal epoch (PersonalSpace.epoch), for what Work writes to their notes while the personal space stays unread (locked).

get.summary: The calling person's own space: the latest turns of their one conversation with Sophia (earlier ones exist when `earlier`), the notes they keep and the notes they carried. Owner-only: nobody else, project admins included, reads any of it. Its `days` are counted in the reader's `timeZone` (an IANA name; UTC without one), over the whole conversation; earlier turns are read back a page at a time (getEarlierPersonalTurns).

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: The reader's IANA time zone (Europe/Madrid), for counting `days`; one the server doesn't know is refused (422).

post.summary: The person is back after a quiet spell: Sophia welcomes them with a turn of hers, written only when the last turn is more than an hour old and is not already a welcome (turnId null otherwise). `name` is the name she greets them by. Never two welcomes in a row, and idempotent by its key: a retry, however late, gets the first receipt, and while one request is getting a welcome another gets nothing written. A welcome not written yet (the companion failed, or an earlier attempt of the same request is still writing it) answers 503 outcome_unknown: ask again under the same key. The request is its key and whom it greets: the same key with another `name` is refused (409 idempotency_conflict), also after an attempt that failed. Where no companion runs, a retry still gets its key's receipt; only new work is refused (503).

post.summary: Delete the conversation, suggestions and notes for good. Carried notes stay in their projects, still the person’s to take back. Every personal write from before it, retried under its key however late, answers 409 request_erased and writes nothing. The space's revision and its turn order go on: a turn after it comes after every earlier one. It is acknowledged once nothing of the space is being asked of the companion, in any process: a call under way is told to stop and waited for (at most about a minute).
